title: [review] duplicate LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION Kconfig block in subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig
description: P3 merge artifact. lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig defines config LICHEN_LINK_COORDINATION twice (duplicate block); Kconfig last-wins so behavior today is fine but the duplicate will silently mask future edits to the first copy. Delete one block, verify west build -b qemu_x86 tests/coap_keys still configures identically.
